newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stocks close slightly higher after dull day.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stocks close slightly higher after dull day.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index edged higher on Wednesday but business remained slow.
Dealers said investors were holding back until they saw companies' first-half trading results, so volume was a light 109,760 shares.
The index rose 0.6 point to 384.63, but most shares ended unchanged.
Pioneer Aluminium and Unilever both added five cedis, to 150 and 955 respectively, while Mobil Oil dropped 30 to 6,400.
